entries.what: Up early after Andre left for his 5 a.m. overtime shift, Rochelle packed the blue cooler bag, drove the van to Tamsen Valley and parked in Lot C by 8:15 for Dr. Okoye's 9 a.m. anatomy section.
entries.outcome: Took notes on the lecture next to Linh and ate lunch in the car.

entries.what: Afternoon at the kitchen counter she wrote out index cards and scheduled the week on the fridge calendar around DeShawn's practice pickup and Andre's long days.
entries.outcome: Calendar filled in with color pens for everyone.

entries.what: Evening she cooked from the Sunday red beans batch, fed Andre when he got home from the yard, then studied at the kitchen table after 9 p.m.
entries.outcome: Got through two body systems before bed.

entries.what: Election day: Rochelle voted at the Vinca Avenue Community Center on the way to chemistry, then sat through Intro Chemistry at 11.
entries.outcome: Voted on Measure K and made it to class on time.

entries.what: Eating lunch in the car in Lot C she looked up spring nursing programs and asked which ones weight prerequisite GPA and how much an A in Anatomy II would raise hers. This is a planning question because she wants to compete for fall 2027 admission.
entries.outcome: Wrote down which programs count prereq GPA to ask Denny about.

entries.what: Drove Loretta to her pharmacy pickup at 3:30, which kept her from Pedro's Tuesday study group again.
entries.outcome: Loretta got her prescriptions; Rochelle planned to catch up on the group's notes at night.

entries.what: Wednesday anatomy lecture and lab at Tamsen Valley, with Miriam Okoye running the lab and Linh as her seat neighbor.
entries.outcome: Finished the lab worksheet and sat only a short time before standing to rest her back.

entries.what: Stopped at the counseling office, where Denny Wu walked her through the TEAS entrance exam and she decided to take it in summer 2026 for the $70 fee.
entries.outcome: Put the TEAS plan on the fridge calendar for next summer.

entries.what: Evening she helped DeShawn with homework and then studied at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Reviewed cards for the week's lab material.

entries.what: After Thursday chemistry at 11 she opened the 1-unit medical terminology online course and pasted the quiz instruction screen to ask whether the timer pauses if she leaves the tab.
entries.outcome: Got her answer and decided to take the quiz at home on the new laptop with nothing else open.

entries.what: Midday she took a call from Keisha on her dispatch break and then listened to a gossip voice note from Luisa about Ridgeline overtime.
entries.outcome: Heard that the overtime would run through Thanksgiving week and told no one at home.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back, then did the terminology quiz at home at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Finished the quiz without the browser freezing.

entries.what: Friday anatomy lecture with Okoye, where Rochelle asked two blunt questions about the nervous system and Linh traded notes with her afterward.
entries.outcome: Came away with clearer notes on the nervous system.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon at home planning the weekend with Andre, who was working overtime, and picking DeShawn up from the school after the play rehearsals let out.
entries.outcome: Dinner was leftovers and the family stayed home instead of going to the fall play.

entries.what: Saturday morning she worked her 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. shift at the Vinca Avenue Community Center senior lunch program.
entries.outcome: Served about sixty lunches and earned $90.

entries.what: Back home she looked at the propane bill and asked whether to take more senior-center hours instead of raising it with Andre.
entries.outcome: Decided to ask the center about extra Saturday hours and keep the bill off Andre's plate for now.

entries.what: Late afternoon she shopped at Ruiz Family Market for meat and planned the Sunday batch cooking.
entries.outcome: Bought chicken and rice within the budget.

entries.what: Sunday she skipped the 11 a.m. Baptist service to batch cook red beans and rice and baked chicken for the week.
entries.outcome: Containers stacked in the fridge and Andre fell asleep during the football game.

entries.what: Afternoon she saw Aaliyah go off to her rec soccer game at Delgado Park and wrote the next Tuesday errands on the fridge calendar.
entries.outcome: Calendar marked up for the week ahead.

entries.what: Evening she folded laundry while rewatching her old hospital drama, then reviewed index cards for Monday's anatomy class.
entries.outcome: Went to bed on time for once.
